name: DeBruijnNewman.norm_sub_le_of_hasDerivAt_segment

name: DeBruijnNewman.prefactor_linear
statement:
theorem prefactor_linear {t x y : ℝ} {z h : ℂ} (hx : 200 ≤ x) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t)
    (hz : z = ((x / 2 + π * t / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)
    (hh : h = (((1 + y) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((-(π * t / 8) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) :
    (1 + y) / 4 * Real.log ((x / 2 + π * t / 8) / (2 * π)) + π ^ 2 * t / 32 -
      ‖h‖ * (3 / (2 * (x / 2 + π * t / 8))) ≤ (h * alpha z).re

name: DeBruijnNewman.prefactor_log_le
statement:

    (hx : 200 ≤ x) :
    t * π ^ 2 / 64 + (logM₀ (((x / 2 + π * t / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)).re - (logM t (sPlus x y)).re ≤
      -((1 + y) / 4) * Real.log (x / (4 * π)) - t / 16 * Real.log (x / (4 * π)) ^ 2 +
        3.58 / (x - 6) + Real.log (x / (4 * π)) / (2 * x ^ 2)

name: DeBruijnNewman.prefactor_taylor

name: DeBruijnNewman.norm_rsIntegral_le_tail
statement:
theorem norm_rsIntegral_le_tail {T c σ : ℝ} {N : ℕ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hc : (N : ℝ) + 1 / 4 ≤ c)
    (hc' : c ≤ N + 3 / 4) (hA : 0 < lineA c T) :
    ‖rsIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + T * I) (N + 1 / 2)‖ ≤

name: DeBruijnNewman.norm_r₀_horizontal_le

    ‖r₀ n ((σ : ℂ) + T * I)‖ ≤ ‖M₀ ((T : ℂ) * I)‖ * Real.exp (1 / (6 * (T - 0.8))) *

name: DeBruijnNewman.norm_tail_le
statement:
theorem norm_tail_le {t x c : ℝ} {N : ℕ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hT : 3 < x / 2)
    (hc : (N : ℝ) + 1 / 4 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ N + 3 / 4) (hA : 0 < lineA c (x / 2))
    (hβ : (1 / (4 * (x / 2) - 12) + 1 / (lineA c (x / 2) * c ^ 2)) * t < 1) (y : ℝ) :
    ‖H t ((x : ℂ) + y * I) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, r t n (sMinus x y) -
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (starRingEnd ℂ) (r t n ((starRingEnd ℂ) (sPlus x y)))‖ ≤
      ‖M₀ (((x / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)‖ *
        (tailIntegral t (x / 2) c ((1 - y) / 2) + tailIntegral t (x / 2) c ((1 + y) / 2))

name: DeBruijnNewman.tailK_eq
statement:
theorem tailK_eq (T c σ : ℝ) :
    tailK T c σ =
      Real.exp (1 / (6 * (T - 0.8))) * (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt (π / lineA c T)) *
        (Real.exp (lineB c T ^ 2 / (4 * lineA c T)) *
          Real.exp (((alpha ((T : ℂ) * I)).re - Real.log c + Real.log 2 / 2) * σ +
            1 / (4 * T - 12) * σ ^ 2) +
        2 / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.exp (lineB c T ^ 2 / (3 * lineA c T)) *
          Real.exp (((alpha ((T : ℂ) * I)).re - Real.log c) * σ +
            (1 / (4 * T - 12) + 1 / (lineA c T * c ^ 2)) * σ ^ 2))

name: DeBruijnNewman.line_params
statement:
theorem line_params {t x : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 1 / 2) (hx : 200 ≤ x) :

    let c := clampC (cutoff t x) a
    (cutoff t x : ℝ) + 1 / 4 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ cutoff t x + 3 / 4 ∧ 3.739 ≤ c ∧
      2.572 ≤ lineA c (x / 2) ∧ lineB c (x / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 5.45 ∧
      |(alpha (((x / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)).re - Real.log c| ≤ 0.067
